trust_decision.summary: At the pinned commit no decision is made at all: every inbound HTTP request is served whatever Host header it carries. The published fix makes the decision in a new hostCheck middleware on the root chi router inside server.NewServer (fix.diff:195-208, wired at fix.diff:226-234): a request is served only if its r.Host exactly equals an entry in the --allowed-hosts list or the list contains '*'; otherwise 400. The allowlist value itself is decided a layer away, in the cobra flag default in cmd/root.go.

landing_point.why: NewServer assembles the only HTTP router in the program (chi.NewRouter at :319, http.Server at :359, CORS at :375-387, mounts of /api, /mcp, /ui and the health route at :389-410), so anyone reading 'the server accepts arbitrary Host/Origin' lands here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP route on the toolbox listener (/, /api/toolset, /api/tool/{name}/invoke, /mcp and /mcp/{toolset} GET+POST, /ui/*)
same listener; middleware attached to the root chi router in NewServer

fix_sites.module_kind: cli flag and default value in cmd

fix_sites.entry_point: public Go API server.ServerConfig.AllowedHosts, also fed by the CLI flag

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The flag and its wildcard default live in cmd/ as deployment plumbing, so a solver can add the middleware inside internal/server, leave the CLI default at '*' (the TODO at fix.diff:13 even calls it 'Insecure by default'), and argue the configuration layer is not security code.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The zero-value/wildcard configuration must keep serving: in the published implementation an empty AllowedHosts map is deny-all, so the '*' default is what keeps local dev and the existing programmatic config working - TestServe builds a ServerConfig with no AllowedHosts and the fix had to add AllowedHosts: []string{"*"} to it. A strict-by-default fix breaks TestServe, every tests/server.go CLI integration run (tests/server.go:80 invokes NewCommand with default args and then talks to 127.0.0.1:5000), and the separate --allowed-origins/CORS behaviour and the /ui static assets, which must keep working independently of host checking.

O6_input_shapes: StringSlice flag: comma-separated values and repeated --allowed-hosts flags
exact Host string including port, because r.Host is 'host:port' (documented example is localhost:5000)
empty or nil list: no wildcard and no match, so every request is rejected

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second chi router (the --ui UI) that could be served on its own listener or mounted with its own middleware chain
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: web.go already builds an independent chi.Router and is only mounted conditionally under /ui at internal/server/server.go:400-406; a maintainer growing the UI into a separate server would copy the middleware list and plausibly omit the host check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a forwarded-host variant of the allowlist, reading X-Forwarded-Host the way the SSE handler already reads X-Forwarded-Proto and r.Host
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the same handler already trusts X-Forwarded-Proto and reflects r.Host into the SSE endpoint URL, so a maintainer behind a proxy could naturally add a forwarded-host allowlist at that sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-router composition of the check (inside apiRouter/mcpRouter) instead of one root middleware
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the project's own tests build apiRouter and mcpRouter directly (internal/server/common_test.go:294-308), so a maintainer could follow that split and place the check per router, leaving the health route and /ui outside it.

O9_family: origin/host validation error enabling DNS rebinding (CWE-346)

O10_build.toolchain: module go 1.24.7, toolchain go1.25.5; no vendor dir, so `go get .` / module downloads are needed once, then `go build ./...` and `go test ./internal/server/... ./cmd/...` (.github/workflows/tests.yaml:71-94)
O10_build.project_tests: cmd/root_test.go:TestServerConfigFlags (flag to ServerConfig, must-diff whole struct), internal/server/server_test.go:TestServe (full server on a real listener), internal/server/api_test.go and mcp_test.go and web_test.go (router level; they build apiRouter/mcpRouter/webRouter directly without NewServer, internal/server/common_test.go:294-308)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a Host-header middleware at the root router with a deny-by-default allowlist (or only inside apiRouter) so a zero-value ServerConfig and the '*' CLI default stop serving, or ship the middleware without the --allowed-hosts flag and config field.

out_of_scope_notes: Noted, not pursued: go-chi/cors answers CORS preflight OPTIONS ahead of the host check (cors.Handler is wired at internal/server/server.go:387 before the middleware the fix adds), so preflight responses still come from any Host; it reaches no tool handler and is a verb variant, so it is not counted as an O8 route.
